source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical ROT13 path introduced by 826 allocates a mutable buffer but copies from a new null line local instead of original_line. Context-only entry 951 removes that unused ROT13 path entirely, and accepted code parses the const input directly. Proposed review rule for similar conversions: trace the source pointer, allocation, copy, mutation and release on every branch; adding a mutable copy does not by itself make a const conversion safe. No historical crash reproduction or current ROT13 defect is claimed.
title: Inspect the copied source when adapting a callback to const input
